entries.name: Seated Cable Rows
entries.reason: Own drawn frames on the Seated Cable Shoulder Press seated pivots (thigh 22.09, shin 31.25) with the feet on the drawn footplate and the low pulley beside it at the foot end. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Six drawn positions of a seated cable row from the long reac

frames.caption: Reach into the start with the arms long and the torso set.
Drive the elbows back past the ribs.
Finish the pull with the upper back engaged.
Pause with the upper back engaged for a beat.
Let the hands travel forward again with control.
Set the torso again before the next pull.
